again.

column2: Same here. It's been a week, hasn't it?
column3: Same here. It's been a week, hasn't it?

column3: Four days, actually.

column2:
I visited you in the hospital. You were still
unconscious, though.
column3:
I visited you in the hospital. You were still
unconscious, though.

column2: Huh. Then you must have seen me naked.
column3: Huh. Then you must have seen me naked.

column2:
Yeah. But you were all wrapped up in
bandages and tubes, so I couldn't do
anything but look.
column3:

column2: Better luck next time.
column3: Better luck next time.

column2: Let's hope so...
column3: Let's hope so...

column2:
But seriously, don't forget that you were like
that until just yesterday. In fact, you really
shouldn't even be on this mission.
column3:

column2: And try not to get yourself hurt.

to nag.

column2:
You're welcome. And I can see you still
don't know when to keep your mouth shut.
column3:
You're welcome. And I can see you still
don't know when to keep your mouth shut.

column2:
Maybe so... By the way, I heard you're
going to lose your medical license if this
mission fails.
column3:

going to lose your medical license if this

column2:
Yes, there was talk of that, but the mission
won't fail, WILL it?
column3:

column2: Of course not.
column3: Of course not.

column2:
Good, I believe in you... But you know
what? I really don't care about my medical
license.
column3:
Good, I believe in you... But you know
what? I really don't care about my medical

column2:
Didn't they use that to force you to
participate in this operation?
column3:
Didn't they use that to force you to
participate in this operation?

column2: No. I volunteered.
column3: No. I volunteered.

column2: Why?
column3: Why?

column2: So that I could watch over you.
column3: So that I could watch over you.

column2:
Snake, you're the best agent I've ever seen.
But you push yourself too hard. You're
reckless.
column3:
Snake, you're the best agent I've ever seen.

reckless.

column2:
Someone has to stop you from getting into
trouble... to make sure you and The Boss
don't kill each other.
column3:
Someone has to stop you from getting into
trouble... to make sure you and The Boss

column2:
So that's why I volunteered. I mean, you
couldn't ask for a better guardian angel
than me, right?
column3:

couldn't ask for a better guardian angel
than me, right?

column2: ...Thanks.
column3: ...Thanks.

column2: Stop right there!
column3: Stop right there!

column2: You can thank me when you get back.
column3: You can thank me when you get back.

column2: All right.
column3: All right.

column2: Para-Medic...
column3: Para-Medic...

column2: ¡Snake! Qué ilusión volver a hablar contigo.
column3: ¡Snake! Qué ilusión volver a hablar contigo.

column2:
Yo digo lo mismo. Hace ya una semana,
¿no?
column3:
Yo digo lo mismo. Hace ya una semana,
¿no?

column2: En realidad, cuatro días.
column3: En realidad, cuatro días.

column2:
Te fui a ver al hospital, aunque seguías
inconsciente.
column3:

inconsciente.

column2: Eh, entonces me has visto desnudo.

que no pude ver nada.

column2: Igual tienes más suerte la próxima vez.
column3: Igual tienes más suerte la próxima vez.

column2: Eso espero...
column3: Eso espero...

column2:
Pero hablando en serio, recuerda que has
estado inconsciente hasta ayer. Es más, no
deberías estar ya en la misión.

Ya, ya... ya veo que no se te ha olvidado
sermonear.

Ya, ya... ya veo que no se te ha olvidado

column2:
De nada, pero tú tampoco has aprendido a
tener la boquita cerrada.

misión fracasa, tú perderás tu licencia médica.

column2:

¿NO?

column2: Pues claro que no.
column3: Pues claro que no.

Que me importa muy poco mi licencia médica.
column3:

column2:

column3: ¿Por qué?

column3: Para poder cuidarte.

Snake, eres el mejor agente que jamás haya
visto. Pero eres demasiado exigente contigo
mismo, y rozas la imprudencia.

column2:
Alguien tiene que evitar que corras peligro...
para evitar que tú y The Boss os matéis.

Y por eso me ofrecí como voluntaria. Y no
creo que encuentres un ángel de la guardia
mejor que yo, ¿no?
